rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf/httpmock idioms, but ships a testing.go importing `testing` into a prod package, unexported error type with exported fields, mixed `%s`/`%w` wrapping, and a hand-written bubble sort.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers symlink/hardlink dupes, empty/dir/size checks, refusal order, code fences; but partial-upload failures still create/update the issue/PR/comment, contradicting 'if one upload fails nothing is written'; ToAppend via strings.Contains on the URL is fragile.
rationale.scope: Delivers the feature, but leaves dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub, UserAsset.markdown), refactors hasDeferredFlags with a subtle `--parent` semantics change, and adds repository fields to every shared issue/PR query.
rationale.readability: references.go is ~700 lines of byte-level `](` scanning and backward bracket matching layered on top of goldmark; upload() is a long chain of near-identical status-code blocks; UploadAndAttach duplicates its append logic.
rationale.robustness: Bodies closed, bounds handled, no obvious panics; but the failure path swallows an error (`res, _ :=`), continues mutations after partial upload failure, and nil Config yields an opaque 'unsupported authentication type'.
rationale.maintainability: Uploader construction is copy-pasted across five commands; KeepExistingBody is a de-facto constant hidden coupling; custom markdown scanner duplicates parser responsibilities and will be hard to evolve.
